acceptance.text: `POST /api/bookmarks` with JSON `{"url": "https://example.com/", "title": "Example"}` returns 201 and a JSON object with `id`, `url`, `title` and `created_at` (UTC, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`)
`GET /api/bookmarks` returns 200 and `{"bookmarks": [...]}` ordered newest first (highest id first)

`POST /api/bookmarks` returns 400 and `{"error": "<message>"}`, and stores nothing, when the body is not a JSON object, `url` is missing or does not start with `http://` or `https://`, or `title` is missing or blank after trimming
`POST /api/bookmarks` with a url that is already stored returns 409 and `{"error": "<message>"}`, and adds no row
`GET /api/bookmarks/<id>` returns 200 and the object for an existing id, and 404 with `{"error": "<message>"}` for an unknown or non-numeric id
`tests/test_bookmarks_api.py` exists, covers AC-F2-1 to AC-F2-5 against the running server, and passes under `verify_tests`; demo target `GET /api/bookmarks` returns 200 under `verify_run`

intent: Expose bookmarks over HTTP: create one, list all (newest first), fetch one by id. Input is validated; a duplicate url is a conflict. Responses are JSON.
title: Bookmarks JSON API
